lines.text: Disney's parks out-earned its movies, TV and streaming two to one.
lines.say: Disney's parks out-earned its movies, TV and streaming, two to one.

lines.text: In fiscal 2025, Disney's Experiences unit, the parks, cruises and merch, earned a record $10 billion.
lines.say: In fiscal twenty twenty-five, Disney's Experiences unit, that's the parks, cruises and merch, earned a record ten billion dollars.

lines.text: The entertainment side, with movies, TV and streaming, earned $4.7 billion.
lines.say: The entertainment side, with movies, TV and streaming, earned four point seven billion.

lines.text: And it's not because parks sell more. Entertainment brought in more revenue: $42.5 billion versus $36.2 billion.
lines.say: And it's not because the parks sell more. Entertainment actually brought in more revenue: forty-two and a half billion, versus thirty-six point two billion.

lines.text: Here's the math: for every $100 of sales, parks kept about $28. Entertainment kept about $11.
lines.say: Here's the math. For every hundred dollars of sales, the parks kept about twenty-eight. Entertainment kept about eleven.

lines.text: Why? A movie is a hit or a flop. A castle sells tickets, hotel rooms, food and merch every single day.
lines.say: Why? A movie is a hit or a flop. A castle sells tickets, hotel rooms, food and merch every single day.

lines.text: And the movies feed the parks: today's hit becomes tomorrow's ride, toy and cruise theme.
lines.say: And the movies feed the parks. Today's hit becomes tomorrow's ride, toy and cruise theme.

lines.text: No wonder Disney said in 2023 it plans to put about $60 billion into parks and cruises over ten years.
lines.say: No wonder Disney said in twenty twenty-three it plans to put about sixty billion dollars into parks and cruises over ten years.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: Disney's parks made double the profit of its movies
post.ig:
Disney's parks out-earned its movies, TV and streaming two to one.

Fiscal 2025 operating income: Experiences (parks, cruises, merch) a record $10.0B; Entertainment (movies, TV, streaming) $4.7B.
Revenue: Entertainment $42.5B vs Experiences $36.2B. Margins: about 28% vs 11%.
Disney plans about $60B of parks and cruise investment over ~10 years (2023).

Sources: Disney FY2025 results and 10-K, Disney (Sept 2023).
